profile.description: Long-running family fair at the Enumclaw Expo Center. The 2026 fair ran July 16-19 and included carnival rides, 4-H/FFA, pig races, kid tractor pulls, music and vendors.

contacts.name: Rene Popke
contacts.role: General Manager, Enumclaw Expo & Event Association

notes.subject: Current King County Fair / Enumclaw Expo relationship review
notes.body: The old unread RMAF response was only an automatic reply and should not be treated as a decline. Current public information confirms the King County Fair remains active and family-focused at the Enumclaw Expo Center. The 2026 fair ran July 16-19 and already included carnival rides and numerous family attractions. Rene Popke is publicly identified as General Manager of the Enumclaw Expo & Event Association. Treat this as a future-year opportunity only if there is a distinct entertainment-area fit beyond the existing carnival.

followUps.label: Review 2027 King County Fair opportunity
followUps.reason: The fair is active and family-focused, but already has carnival rides. Check the 2027 entertainment plan early before deciding whether Adventure Zone adds something distinct.
